capabilities: Convert handwriting files (.note, .pdf) to Excalidraw or Markdown format
Extract handwritten text via OCR (Tesseract.js or Google Cloud Vision) to make notes searchable
Watch external folders and automatically convert new or updated handwriting files
Download and convert handwriting files from Google Drive folders via API
Convert dropped handwriting files via drag & drop into the file explorer
extras: Not yet published in the Obsidian Community Plugin directory; install via BRAT or build from source. Desktop only (needs Node.js filesystem access). Google Cloud Vision free tier allows 1,000 pages/month; Tesseract.js language data (~15 MB per language) is downloaded on first use and OCR then runs locally. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: The usual workaround — syncing handwriting files to Google Drive and opening them as PDFs — keeps your notes accessible but isolated.
motivation: The author built it because using both pen and keyboard splits knowledge between handwritten files on an e-ink tablet and typed notes in Obsidian, and the usual Google Drive PDF workaround keeps handwriting isolated.
problem: Handwriting exported from e-ink tablets stays as flat, unsearchable files outside the vault, cut off from Obsidian search, links, tagging, and graph view.

relations.evidence: Excalidraw format requires the Excalidraw plugin
supports Tesseract.js (local) and Google Cloud Vision (API)
images are sent to Google servers for text recognition. Requires a user-provided API key.
the Google Drive API adapter detects changes and downloads files directly via API

requires.name: Google account (OAuth2 for Google Drive API)

summary: Converts handwritten note files (.note, .pdf) from e-ink tablets into searchable Excalidraw or Markdown notes in the vault, with OCR.
